title: MZ Scaling Down GUI for Low Res Games

posts.author: JimFrom2003
posts.body: I'm trying to make a low resolution game a la RPG Maker 2000/2003, but when I decrease the tile size and increase the zoom, GUI elements like text boxes and menus are way too big and/or malformed from not having enough room on the game window. Are there any good plugins, scripts or at least tutorials for scaling down everything, because going into the javascript and editing them manually is a pain.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Unfortunately, there's no easy way. Because there are many values to be take cared of. Like message box padding, line height, font size, icon size, layout, skin, etc.
Maybe you can scale up your resources 2x, make it like big pixel style, and scale the whole game window down by 1/2?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There have been a good number of threads about this - the common solution is what
@utunnels
said, to scale up the low-res artwork.
Is there a specific reason you want your game to run in an uncomfortably small window? Who is going to want to squint at it and play it?
